entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Um, yes. I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this all works, it's a bit confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Michael Chen. The order number is... uh, hold on... VF-881-624-9.
Thank you, Michael. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes from about a month and a half ago. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes, that's right, the cycling shoes. They just don't feel right at all. I'm so overwhelmed by all the settings and things.

I understand it can be a lot to get used to. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes, or more of a sizing or comfort preference?

I don't know if it's a fault... I just know they hurt. I tried adjusting the cleats like the videos showed, but no matter what I do, I get terrible blisters on my heels. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back for a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters, Michael. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it here. Since you received the cycling shoes 48 days ago, you are still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items.
Oh, really? That's a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. So I can get a full refund?

Absolutely. I am processing that return authorization for you now. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's great. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome, Michael. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again for your help!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
